speaker: george_peele
text: Shakespeare! Still alive and still in Shoreditch. I've a poem on the tilt. Every horse in it rhymes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the horses are working harder than I am. I am a hundred yards off the rail.

speaker: george_peele
text: Titus is still playing, they tell me. Do they still laugh in the wrong place?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They laugh where they laugh. I am not here to mend it.

speaker: george_peele
text: A groat for a poor poet? No? Wise man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not today. I have paid twelve pence to stand here. That is the day's charity.

speaker: george_peele
text: Keep it. I have a roll of paper and a long walk. We have nodded. That will do for old soldiers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We have nodded. Go on, if you are going. I am staying till they are done.
